description: Crypto options chain (Deribit) for one underlying and expiry: calls/puts by strike with bid/ask/mark (native and USD), mark IV, calculated Black-76 delta, open interest (coins and USD notional) and 24h volume. Lists every available expiry. Underlyings: BTC and ETH (deep; inverse and USDC-linear books), SOL, XRP, HYPE, AVAX, TRX (USDC-linear, thin). Defaults: next expiry, strikes within ±10% of spot, both types.

expiry.description: "next" (default), a date like "2026-12-25", or an exchange code like "25DEC26".

moneyness_pct.description: When no strike bounds are given: keep strikes within ± this % of spot. Default 10.

name: options_chain

contracts.description: Contracts of that expiry inside the strike range and type filter, by strike; the strikes nearest spot when truncated to the limit

deltaCalculated.description: Black-76 delta on the forward, r=0 (calculated)

mark.description: Venue mark price, native premium units

openInterestUsd.description: Open interest notional, USD (calculated at the spot index)

settlement.description: inverse = premium in the coin, linear = in USDC

daysToExpiry.description: Days from now to that expiry

expiries.description: Every listed future expiry, ISO 8601 UTC, nearest first

expiry.description: The expiry shown, ISO 8601 UTC (08:00 UTC settlement); absent when the venue lists no options

forwardUsd.description: Forward (underlying) price the venue priced that expiry off, USD

indexPriceUsd.description: Spot index of the underlying, USD

meta.description: Provenance of the snapshot the numbers come from

ageSeconds.description: Seconds between the observation and this response

observedAt.description: When the venue snapshot was observed, ISO 8601 UTC

metricSources.description: Which fields the venue reports and which this server calculates

calculated.description: Fields calculated here from reported data

reported.description: Fields taken as reported by the venue

title: Options Chain
